FN-UENMDX-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 489
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Ben Robbins
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 05/23/2023
House Bill 489 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of: (1) each local
board of education by preventing students from accessing social media on school-provided
internet and by requiring students entering ninth-grade to complete one semester of instruction
on the use of social media; and (2) the State Board of Education by requiring the adoption of
rules to implement the provisions of this bill, beginning with the 2024-2025 school year.
This bill will also increase the administrative obligations of the State Department of Education
and the local boards of education by requiring each entity to publish curriculum material on their
respective websites, and for the local board of education to inform parents how to access the
material.
